aqua_insights.root_cause_hypothesis: All 36 WORKFLOW_TOOLS were statically bound on root_agent alongside load_skill and execute_mcp_tool, allowing the LLM to invoke run_*_workflow directly on Turn 1 without progressive skill or schema discovery.
aqua_insights.remediation_proposal: Set default disclosure_mode='dual_progressive' (or 'skill_toolset') in get_agent_tools() so only the 9 meta-discovery tools are bound at Turn 0 and all 36 workflow tools are registered in global_mcp_registry.
